messages:
alex: Heads-up — we're seeing a sudden spike in 5xxs from edge services in eu-west-1 starting ~07:15 UTC. Initial signs point to NAT gateway port exhaustion + conntrack growth. Service logs show a lot of "connection reset by peer" on model-pull paths and envoy sidecars throwing Errno 24.

maria: :eyes: I pulled CloudWatch for NATGateway.AllocatedPorts and it's pegged in two AZs. Also conntrack on a node shows a TON of TIME_WAIT.

raj: Quick check from bastion:
```
sudo ss -tan | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l
# => 245678
```
Not normal.

sam: Did we change anything around the sidecar? The new HTTP/2 multiplexer landed this week. Could it be opening upstream TCP per stream?

alex: Yeah the v1.4.7 sidecar changed upstream connection handling to prefer new connections in some codepaths (intended to reduce head-of-line blocking). Looks like in practice it's causing extreme fanout to specific model hosts.

maria: CloudWatch metrics: AllocatedPorts ~ 51200/51200 in eu-west-1a and eu-west-1b at 07:18. Errors spike correlates with model fetch traffic.

ops-oncall: Triage plan: 1) throttle new sidecar canaries, 2) spin up an extra NATGW in affected AZs, 3) create an S3 VPC endpoint and route artifact pulls via it, 4) enable temporary egress proxy with connection pooling. Conntrack/tuning is risky in prod.

infra-bot: deploy rollback initiated: sidecar v1.4.7 -> v1.4.6 (canary 20% eu-west-1) :rocket:

alex: Pushing the rollback and enabling a small regional cache proxy (127.0.0.1:4000) as a stopgap for model pulls. Will add a header so we can track hits.

raj: After rollback and proxy changes, AllocatedPorts dropped to ~31k within 8 minutes and 5xxs are trending down. Still seeing elevated TIME_WAIT counts but connection errors are rare now.

maria: Root cause: sidecar hotloop where new upstream TCPs were created instead of reusing multiplexed channels; amplified by model-pull fanout to a small set of storage IPs (dest IP affinity). Action items:
- fix sidecar to actually reuse HTTP/2 multiplexing or fall back properly
- add canary gating for network-sensitive changes
- build egress playbook: pre-provision NATGW capacity, regional egress proxies with pooling, and make artifact hosting more distributed / use VPC endpoints

sam: Also worth investigating an Envoy bug where TIME_WAIT piles up when keepalive is disabled in multiplexing mode. I'll open a tracker.

ops-oncall: Follow-ups: schedule 1h incident retro, document the emergency NAT scale runbook, and add monitoring alert for NATGateway.AllocatedPorts >= 80% for >2m.

alex: Thanks team — rollback + proxy mitigated the immediate pain. I'll draft the postmortem and assign owners for the follow-ups. :thumbsup:
